name: World of Warcraft: Forever
storyline: Journey through an updated and expanded Azeroth dense with new stories and secrets hidden across familiar vistas and never-before-seen locales.
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure.
